submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile/trirutile (CoSb2O6-type) phase across the whole line, with an extra Sb-oxide phase showing up at the Sb-rich end (peaks near Q≈2.43–2.46 and 3.63). Measured EQE: idx15 (Sb 0.53) = 0.0097%, idx22 (Sb 0.75) = 0.0155%, idx26 (Sb 0.83) ≈ 0%. The highest measured EQE is at idx22, in the Sb-rich trirutile region, before the Sb-oxide phase takes over and EQE drops off.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE ≈ 0 (-0.002%); XRD shows a strong Sb-oxide second phase
Not measured; EQE went up toward the Sb-rich side from idx15, and XRD shows rutile plus minor extra peaks with no sign of a better phase
